current_backend: Finite preintegrated linear/bilinear synthetic kernels only; reconstructed physical validators use their separate explicit interfaces.
scope_rules: Require an explicit exact string in the job, data and kernel JSON objects. Do not infer a job's scope from inputs or supply a missing scope by default.
Reject production, reconstructed_theory, experimental_candidate, historical_benchmark_candidate and all unknown, missing, empty or non-string scopes.
Check the job object and scope before data/kernel IO, numerical dispatch, thread reconfiguration or output creation.
The loader checks the data object/scope before opening the kernel, then checks the kernel object/scope before constructing its numerical context.
After loading, require job/data/kernel scope equality. A production request must never execute a synthetic fallback.
Relabeling a synthetic fixture as production does not implement a production backend or authorize scientific admission. A metadata boolean cannot enable it.
unchanged_numerics: No change to predictions, parameter transformations, covariance/nuisance likelihood, optimizer, replicas, integration, source conventions, evolution, cuts or data overlap.
All numerical evaluation remains Julia; the guard runs once at the JSON entry/loading boundary, not inside the numerical loop.
Existing explicit synthetic jobs remain supported; no production job is implemented here.
validation: Preserve the pre-fix read-only gap probe and failing targeted loader tests; no production fit is executed by these probes.
Reject unsupported or missing job scopes with absent input paths, proving rejection precedes input IO and any fit action.
Reject relabeled production inputs, candidate/reconstructed scopes, missing fields, scalar aliases and non-object roots; rejected requests create no output.
Execute a valid explicitly synthetic benchmark job and the complete Linux regression/closure workflow.
future_production_requirement: A separate implemented scientific admission path with reviewed physical data/kernels, benchmarks and frozen production policy is required before extending the executor. Do not replace this guard with a boolean override.
limitations: This is a declared JSON-interface consistency boundary, not a cryptographic authorization system or a sandbox for arbitrary trusted Julia code.
It does not certify physical processes, experimental data, a historical fit, performance or interval coverage. All existing scientific prerequisites remain.
